This leaf is found chiefly in cold climates, especially in mountains, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains hard to find.

A Darsurion leaf is applied directly to a wound, restoring 1–6 concussion hits. No prior decoction is required, but the plant remains difficult to locate in the cold mountains where it grows. Its simple use makes it worthwhile whenever it can be obtained.
